- Current constraints: quarterly budget window, internal security checklist (SOC2 evidence), and strict inbound IP rules.

Proposed next step: 60-minute infra deep-dive (we'll bring an infra engineer and a solutions lead). Please pick one of these slots and I will send a calendar invite with the Zoom link and an agenda:
- Option A: Wed Sep 1, 2026 — 11:00–12:00 PT
- Option B: Thu Sep 2, 2026 — 14:00–15:00 PT
- Option C: Fri Sep 3, 2026 — 09:00–10:00 PT

Ask: can you confirm the SSO/IDP contact (name + email) to include on the invite so our engineer can bring the right config notes and test plan? Also flag any additional attendees from your side (security or network).

Attachments: mutual-action-plan.pdf (outline + proposed timeline), platform-overview-ops.pptx (short ops-focused deck).

If nothing fits, tell us two alternatives and we’ll adapt.

Thanks,
Diego Fernandez
